description:
Proposed Development

The proposal comprises the construction of a single-storey rear infill extension within the existing rear courtyard area of the property. The extension will provide approximately 9m² of additional internal floorspace and will feature a flat roof with a glazed rooflight to maximise natural daylight.

The rear elevation of the extension will incorporate slim-framed glazed doors opening onto the rear garden. In addition, the existing rear kitchen window opening will be enlarged and replaced with new glazed doors to improve access to the garden and strengthen the relationship between the internal living accommodation and the external space.

The proposed extension has been designed to remain subservient to the host dwelling and will utilise materials that complement the existing building. The scale, form and appearance of the works are modest and are considered to preserve the character and appearance of the property and the surrounding area, while providing a high-quality improvement to the internal accommodation.
